new_hypothesis.name: convergence_without_chase
new_hypothesis.mechanism: wallet_convergence's edge is information asymmetry: tracked smart-money wallets buy a token BEFORE the broader market reacts, and the bot front-runs the resulting price impact. That asymmetry only pays if the bot enters AHEAD of the move. When price_change_5m is already strongly positive (>+4% in the last 5 minutes), the smart-money buy has ALREADY been expressed in price — the bot is no longer front-running, it is buying the same candle as the retail reaction, arriving last into a spike that mean-reverts. Empirically every WC entry made into a hot 5m candle dumped 12-13%. Requiring a flat/quiet 5m at entry guarantees the wallet signal still has unexpressed alpha left to capture.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Structural, not a curve-fit constant. Front-running only earns while you enter before price impact; the instant price has moved, the asymmetry is gone for ALL participants, permanently and regime-independently. The veto locks the bot to the only window where the edge mechanically exists, so it does not decay as regimes shift. It is also not arbitrage-able away by others because it is a constraint on OUR own entry timing, not a public signal.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Add a HARD VETO to wallet_convergence entries: if price_change_5m > +4.0%, SKIP (do not enter, do not size down — a full veto). Secondary soft condition supported by the data: also skip if vol_liq_ratio > 25 (over-churned froth). Both conditions co-occur on the 3 catastrophic losses. The veto is additive to existing WC entry logic (the run-287 dead-book floor stays).
new_hypothesis.data_required: Already in the bot's enrichment payload — price_change_5m and vol_liq_ratio are present on every WC trade-log entry. No new data source needed; this is a pure entry-gate using fields already computed at scan time.
new_hypothesis.evidence: Mined all 14 closed WC trades + 28 WC trade-log entries. WINS entered calm: SQUIRE +2.32% (pc5m -0.75), Butt +17.43% (pc5m -2.73), Ball +0.79% (pc5m 0), TROLL +0.27% (pc5m -0.04). LOSSES entered hot: Bumpy -13.43% (pc5m +13.8), soothsayer -13.08% (pc5m hot), ASTEROID -12.50% (pc5m hot) — the 3 worst WC losses ever, combined ~-39%. Median pc5m: wins ~0%, losses +5.2%. The single rule pc5m<=+4% cleanly separates 8 wins from the 3 catastrophic losses; calm-entry subset (11T) = +11.2% net vs all-in -27.8%. Wallet COUNT (3 vs 4) shows NO edge (nW=4 trades went +17.43, +0.27, -8.21, -13.08). NOTE: source_wallet identity is NOT logged (empty on all 28 entries) — a data gap; see proposal #4.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: RECALIBRATE the Phase-2 'MEV storm' spike threshold BEFORE any Phase-2 modifier ships. The logger (sol_jito_tipfloor_log.json) now holds 20,000 real entries over 2.43 days. The proposed threshold of ratio(p99/ema_p50)>200 is catastrophically mis-set: the MEDIAN observed ratio is 206, so >200 fires on ~half of all polls = 674 sustained episodes/day — a regime flag stuck permanently ON, signalling nothing. Also note the actual log field names are 'p99' and 'ema_p50' (NOT the verbose landed_tips_* names assumed in research-144). Data-driven recommendation: set the spike threshold to ratio > 25,000 → ~5.4 sustained episodes/day (a usable 'handful per day'); ratio>40,000 gives ~3.3/day if tighter is wanted. Avoid mean+Nsigma here — sigma is dominated by a 159,400 max outlier; a fixed absolute cut is more stable.
